title: Customer replies while the owner agent is ON VACATION ? case goes to the next available agent | APPR | Controllable (Code 96 � Operations Control) | Delay 6 to under 9 hrs | 1 Pax | 1 Leg | Basic Aeroplan
description:
Checks that a parked case isn't left with an agent who is on vacation. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late (Code 96, Controllable). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. The customer leaves the chat before payment. Agent Sarah Martin sends "Action Required" with the secure payment link and parks the case. On Aug 12 a supervisor sets Sarah to On Leave (Aug 12 � Aug 26). The pre-leave sweep must remove Sarah's ownership right away and move the case to "To Be Assigned", keeping all history. On Aug 14 (day 13, within 30 days) the customer replies. The case is already in the queue. The next Available agent, Marc Dubois, gets it with "Get Next Case", opens it within 10 minutes (In Progress) and completes the case. The customer lives in Canada and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected. When Sarah comes back, the case must not return to her.

Prerequisites:
PNR: PK004 � single passenger Mathieu Roy (Adult, Basic Aeroplan 9876543210, good standing). AC 412 YUL ? YYZ, July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual 19:00 (7h delay). Code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed Jul 28, 2026. No duplicate. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Owner agent: Sarah Martin. Supervisor: Nadia Bouchard. Next agent: Marc Dubois (Available, same queue, qualified for FD). Park date: Aug 1. On Leave set: Aug 12, 09:00 (leave Aug 12 � Aug 26). Customer reply: Aug 14, 10:00. Marc pulls the case: Aug 14, 10:15.
